public_rationale: The graded claim is hedged: generative AI 'does not appear' to give easy returns like the cloud and app-store booms. It is tested against how things looked when he wrote it. Two prominent finance sources from the same weeks said much the same. Sequoia's June 20, 2024 analysis put the gap between AI infrastructure spending and the revenue needed to justify it at about $500B. Goldman Sachs research on June 25–27, 2024 said gen AI spending 'has little to show for it so far'. There is a partial counterpoint: AI was adding 7 points to Microsoft's Azure growth, and chip suppliers were earning heavily. But neither shows easy, broad returns for those deploying gen AI. His impression matched mainstream assessments of the time. The forecast that markets will punish the most invested has no deadline and is not graded here.
limitations: The claim is hedged and has no measure, so this grade tests only whether credible contemporary assessments shared his impression.
Analyst views were mixed. Goldman's report also included more optimistic voices.
The cloud and app-store comparison is not quantified.

Supported if credible assessments available around the post date said generative AI spending had not yet produced matching business returns or revenue. Contradicted if the visible picture at that time was of easy, broad returns, such as revenue clearly covering the investment.
The attached forecast ('markets will punish those most deeply invested') has no deadline and is outside this claim's normalized proposition. It is not scored here.
Period: the time of writing (first half of 2024), because the hedge refers to how things appeared then. No narrower quarter is imposed.
criteria.support_condition: Credible financial analyses or reports from around mid-2024 conclude that generative AI investment had little to show in returns or revenue so far.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible analyses from around mid-2024 show generative AI was already giving easy, broad business returns, with revenue clearly matching investment.
